infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Argus uses your camera to see what's in front of you in real time so it can help with everyday tasks — for example, pointing your camera at ingredients so Argus can suggest a recipe, or at a broken appliance so it can talk you through a fix. Camera frames are streamed live to Google's Gemini AI for analysis and are not stored by Argus.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Argus uses your microphone to hear you speak so you can have a natural spoken conversation — for example, asking "what can I make with this?" while showing Argus your fridge. Your voice audio is streamed live to Google's Gemini AI to generate a spoken response and is not stored by Argus.
